name: Ryan
source: Ryan is the protagonist's best friend. A lover of using narcotic mixtures, he produces himself. Despite his apparent lightheartedness, he has a profound knowledge of chemistry and biology. Ryan often engages in self-talk after consuming his homemade narcotic concoctions. He claims to have a hereditary predisposition to drug manufacture because his father served two terms in prison for drug manufacture.
